    WHERE (leaf:Set OR leaf:Minifig)

         reduce(qty = 1, r IN rels | qty * r.qty) AS path_qty
    OPTIONAL MATCH (leaf)-[:HAS_INVENTORY]->(leaf_inv:Inventory)

WITH root, max([(root)-[r:CONTAINS]->() | r.version]) AS currentVersion

OPTIONAL MATCH (root)-[direct:CONTAINS {version: currentVersion}]->(p:Part)

// Exploded contents through nested sets and minifigs (recursive paths)

  AND all(r IN relationships(path) WHERE r.is_spare = false)
WITH root, directQty, path, part, relationships(path) AS rels
WITH root, directQty, sum(reduce(acc = 1, r IN rels | acc * r.qty)) AS nestedQty

RETURN round(100.0 * nestedQty / (directQty + nestedQty), 2) AS percentage

WITH s
// Get current version
OPTIONAL MATCH (s)-[c:CONTAINS]->()
WITH s, max(c.version) AS current_version
// Collect part numbers from current inventory (recursive, excluding spare parts)
CALL {
  WITH s, current_version
  MATCH path = (s)-[:CONTAINS {version: current_version}]->()-[:CONTAINS*0..]->(p:Part)
  WHERE all(r IN relationships(path) WHERE r.is_spare = false OR r.is_spare IS NULL)
  WITH DISTINCT p.part_num AS part_num
  RETURN collect(part_num) AS current_parts
}
// Collect part numbers from version 1 inventory (recursive, excluding spare parts)
CALL {
  WITH s
  MATCH path = (s)-[:CONTAINS {version: 1}]->()-[:CONTAINS*0..]->(p:Part)
  WHERE all(r IN relationships(path) WHERE r.is_spare = false OR r.is_spare IS NULL)
  WITH DISTINCT p.part_num AS part_num
  RETURN collect(part_num) AS v1_parts
}
// Find parts in current but not in version 1
WITH [p IN current_parts WHERE NOT p IN v1_parts] AS diff_parts
UNWIND diff_parts AS part_num
RETURN part_num
ORDER BY part_num
